_comment: Random map generator (start screen tab 'Zufallsgenerator'). Values per setting level: few/medium/many (treasures: off/normal/many). Shares are of the land, counts per player.
_layout: seaMargin: water fields at the map edge; startDistance: start points this share of the land radius from the center; homeRadius: what the players' surroundings guarantee (mountain, pond with stream, forest, stones) lies within it, with 'Wiederholung' it is copied to every player.
_resources: cover: share of mountain fields with ore (veins), amount: range of the amount (0-15 as in the original maps); fish: amount in shallow water.
_treasureGoods: Material: weight. A site has 1-3 piles of 3-8.
_hoard: Treasures 'many' only: a large heap in the middle of the map, full piles on every field within the radius (material: weight).
